---
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}

jobs:
  validation-plan:
    name: Validation plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan }}
      profile: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.profile }}
      select_quality: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_quality }}
      select_lockfile_release_age: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Plan from independently trusted policy
        id: plan
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci plan \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}" --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

  quality:
    name: Format, lint, test, and build
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_quality == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Install pinned Node.js toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 26.13.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: source/package-lock.json
      - name: Install checksum-pinned native file-quality tools
        env:
          PROFILE: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tool_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/boxferry-website-tools"
          if [[ "${PROFILE}" == full ]]; then
            bash source/scripts/install-file-tools.sh "${tool_dir}"
          else
            bash source/scripts/install-file-tools.sh "${tool_dir}" --lychee-only
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${tool_dir}" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
      - name: Run the independently selected website tasks
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          BOXFERRY_WEBSITE_FORMAT_MODE: check
          BOXFERRY_WEBSITE_SOURCE_MODE: locked
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci run-local \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --report-json "${RUNNER_TEMP}/website-validation.json" \
            --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
      - name: Retain structured website validation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: website-validation-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/website-validation.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      statuses: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs: [validation-plan, quality, lockfile-release-age]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Require exact-candidate planned outcomes
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: b191fb5ffe32fe84d9cb0c851562044b0f0cc59b
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}" \
            --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

  publish-site:
    name: Publish validated website
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.pr-gate.result == 'success'
    needs: [pr-gate]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- Same-commit reusable workflow; pinned actionlint 1.7.12 lacks $/ support.
    secrets:
      BOXFERRY_RSYNC_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOXFERRY_RSYNC_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      BOXFERRY_VERSION_UPDATER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOXFERRY_VERSION_UPDATER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
    with:
      operation: deploy
      revision: ${{ github.sha }}
      automatic: true
